# <!--name-->edot-release/pr-range<!--/name-->

[![usages](https://img.shields.io/badge/usages-white?logo=githubactions&logoColor=blue)](https://github.com/search?q=elastic%2Foblt-actions%2Fedot-release%2Fpr-range+%28path%3A.github%2Fworkflows+OR+path%3A**%2Faction.yml+OR+path%3A**%2Faction.yaml%29&type=code)
[![test-edot-release-pr-range](https://github.com/elastic/oblt-actions/actions/workflows/test-edot-release-pr-range.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/elastic/oblt-actions/actions/workflows/test-edot-release-pr-range.yml)

<!--description-->
List the pull requests contributing to an EDOT release range. The caller must check out full history and tags.
<!--/description-->

## Inputs

<!--inputs-->
| Name           | Description                                                                  | Required | Default                    |
|----------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|----------------------------|
| `ref`          | Commit or ref at the end of the range.                                       | `false`  | `${{ github.sha }}`        |
| `previous-tag` | Release tag at the start of the range. Defaults to the highest matching tag. | `false`  | ` `                        |
| `tag-prefix`   | Prefix on release tags, such as v. Leave empty for plain X.Y.Z tags.         | `false`  | ` `                        |
| `repository`   | GitHub repository whose pull requests are resolved.                          | `false`  | `${{ github.repository }}` |
| `github-token` | GitHub token used by the commits API.                                        | `false`  | `${{ github.token }}`      |
<!--/inputs-->

## Outputs

<!--outputs-->
| Name    | Description                                                                   |
|---------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `range` | JSON containing the previous tag, range SHAs, and contributing pull requests. |
<!--/outputs-->

## Usage

The repository must be checked out with full history and tags.

<!--usage action="elastic/oblt-actions/edot-release/pr-range" version="env:VERSION"-->
```yaml
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    with:
      fetch-depth: 0
  - uses: elastic/oblt-actions/edot-release/pr-range@v1
    with:
      tag-prefix: v
```
<!--/usage-->
